DIFFICULTY.description: Controls how challenging the game is, affecting mob damage, hunger drain, and natural health regeneration.

HARDCORE.description: Players are banned from the server upon death. Difficulty is locked to Hard when enabled.

PVP.description: Allow players to deal damage to each other.

MODE.description: The default game mode for new players joining the server.

FORCE_GAMEMODE.description: Force players to join in the default game mode. When disabled, players rejoin in the mode they left in.

ENABLE_COMMAND_BLOCK.description: Allow command blocks to be used on the server.

ALLOW_NETHER.description: Allow players to travel to the Nether. When disabled, nether portals will not work.

SPAWN_ANIMALS.description: Allow passive mobs (animals) to spawn naturally in the world.

SPAWN_MONSTERS.description: Allow hostile mobs (monsters) to spawn naturally. Has no effect when difficulty is set to Peaceful.

SPAWN_NPCS.description: Allow villagers and other NPCs to spawn naturally in villages.

SIMULATION_DISTANCE.description: The maximum distance from players (in chunks) that living entities are updated. Lower values improve performance.

VIEW_DISTANCE.description: The amount of world data sent to the client, measured in chunks. Lower values reduce bandwidth and improve performance.

SEED.description: Seed for world generation. Leave empty for a random seed. Use a specific value to generate the same world layout.

LEVEL.description: The name of the world save directory. Changing this switches to a different world save.

LEVEL_TYPE.description: The type of world to generate. Only applies when a new world is created.

GENERATE_STRUCTURES.description: Generate structures such as villages, dungeons, and temples. Only applies when a new world is created.

SPAWN_PROTECTION.description: The radius (in blocks) around the world spawn point where non-operator players cannot build. Set to 0 to disable.

EULA.description: Must be TRUE to accept Mojang's End User License Agreement.

VERSION.description: Minecraft version to run (e.g. 1.21.4). Set to LATEST to always use the newest release.

connection-info.content: Open Minecraft Java Edition and add a server with address **localhost:25565**. On other computers on your local network, use your Mac's local IP address instead of localhost.
